key_insight: HAVAPlot enables browser-only scientific visualization and post-processing of simulation data without software installation or data uploads.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can inspect native OpenFOAM, VTK, and tabular datasets locally and export publication-ready vector graphics and processed data.
method: Read native OpenFOAM meshes, fields, boundaries, and particles alongside VTK and tabular data.
Apply exact polyhedral slicing, variable calculations, streamlines, isosurfaces, and particle visualization.
Verify mesh geometry, field reading, and interpolation against independent implementations and analytical fields.
evidence_signal: Across four production cases, 6.1 million field values were reproduced to machine precision; interpolation showed second-order interior and first-order boundary convergence, and 250,000-cell meshes loaded in at most 1.3 seconds.
watch_item: Browser memory and performance for datasets substantially larger than the reported 250,000-cell loading benchmark remain unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: HAVAPlot: A Web-Based Scientific Visualization and Post-Processing Platform
